description: readiness rc.7 pass 5 F-19: D/.jos names the directory D (SPEC-2.0 §9.1). `validate D/.jos` validates the directory D, as `validate D` does, and `run D/.jos` runs D/.jos/manifest.jos in D: both 0 for a valid folder. Before the fix `validate D/.jos` looked for D/.jos/.jos/manifest.jos and gave 2 while `run D/.jos` gave 0.
